decision: No blocker in the frozen source-only detector plan for the already-authorized exact download and isolated setup stage. Concrete runner/native setup review remains required before the first detector forward.
independent_annotation_rule: Keep outside detector worker access/input. Review only after raw detector outputs are preserved.
runner_checks_still_required: Verify downloaded exact hashes/size, installed inspected GLiNER code, same local tokenizer/builtin model classes, strict state load, and no attempted network access.
Register complete native input comparison before any underlying model forward; compare full input IDs, attention mask and source-word mapping to truncation-disabled preflight for each case.
Enforce initialization/per-case/total deadlines and 6144 MiB owned-process-tree cap externally, preserve partial/raw failures, and verify cleanup even if the leader exits first.
Supply only joined source plus person label to native prediction; exclude annotations, semantic criteria, references and prior translations from worker inputs.
limitations: A compatible declared dependency set does not establish successful native import/load/tokenizer conversion; actual setup must fail closed.
No model payload download, detector import, model construction, forward, or new translation was performed by this reviewer.
A successful detector-only source screen would support only a separately reviewed protected-translation experiment; it would not establish general NER or translation correctness.
